Search precision: five retrieval strategies

Eight preselected pieces from seven outfit cases. Every strategy gets two queries, at most six listings per query, and the same strict photo checker. Verification is run separately per arm; the judge sees unique listings ordered by ID without query strategy or acceptance decisions. The eBay arm changes both source and query. Grade 3 means faithful color, silhouette and visible details; ambiguous photos do not receive credit.

Development experiment, not a held-out benchmark. Same gpt-5.4 service supplies the separate rank-blind judge and matcher; errors can be correlated. Current query responses can be cached while new queries are fresh, so inventory drift is a confound. The combined pool uses up to five times the retrieval/photo-check budget. No production behavior changed.
